SECURITY ADVISORY (5/5)                 
========================================
> UBUNTU USN                            
  USN: 9063-1: Yodl vulnerability       
                                        
  It was discovered that Yodl           
  incorrectly handled certain input,    
  leading to a buffer over-read. An     
  attacker could possibly use this issue
  to cause Yodl to crash, resulting in a
  denial of service.                    
                                        
  Source: Ubuntu USN (Wed, 11 Nov 2026)
